description.value: Coasters Coffee is an independent cafe in New Westminster founded by two sisters who designed the space around a West Coast nature aesthetic, bringing the feel of the outdoors inside. The cafe sources its coffee from local roasters committed to organic and ethical growing practices, and its loose-leaf teas from a 100% Canadian-owned supplier. Touring cyclists will find a calm indoor setting with a broad menu of specialty espresso drinks, teas, matcha, and food including salads and pastries.
